summary: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 01:10 - Fixed both live-subs overlay usability bugs reported after the user's first real run. Root cause of BOTH was the same: the window auto-sized to its content. (1) Clipping: QMainWindow.adjustSize() asks a word-wrapped QLabel for a sizeHint, but such a label cannot report true height without being given a width first, so tall multi-line cues were cut off. Now _relayout() sets a fixed label width and asks heightForWidth() explicitly. (2) Wandering centre: because width tracked content, every cue of a different length shifted the text's visual centre and the user had to keep repositioning. Width is now FIXED (--width, default 0.72 of screen) and the window is anchored by the centre of its BOTTOM edge, so captions grow upward instead of drifting; the anchor is re-captured on drag release so it grows from wherever it was dropped. Caught a third bug via the regression test that manual testing would likely have missed: setFixedHeight makes heightForWidth() report the pinned value on later passes, so the box could only ever GROW - a single long cue left a permanently oversized empty box. Fixed by releasing min/max height before each measurement. Added tray Box wider/narrower actions, -Width parameter on Start-LiveSubtitles.ps1 and in vw-commands.ps1. VERIFIED by automated layout test: centre x stable at 768 across short/long/short cues, bottom edge stable at 735, box grows upward (top 664->628), shrinks back (h 72->108->72), zero clipping at every step, and width nudge preserves the centre.
